costNote: Mining and converting lithium and bromine — including expensive spodumene feedstock processed this quarter. A year ago gross margin was just 9%; lithium pricing recovery lifted it to 19%.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Held flat while sales rose 19% — part of more than $150M of run-rate cost and productivity savings delivered year to date.

opex.name: Restructuring & asset write-offs
opex.note: Charges from the ongoing footprint and cost program.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Process and product development, trimmed as spending was refocused.

otherDetail.label: Equity earnings of joint ventures
otherDetail.note: Albemarle's share of profits from its lithium joint ventures (chiefly Talison in Australia, which pays the dividends that funded much of this quarter's cash flow). Reported after tax — and bigger than operating income itself.

otherDetail.label: Interest & financing expenses
otherDetail.note: Down from $51M a year ago as debt was paid down.

footerNote: Net income is the consolidated $317M; $297M was attributable to Albemarle and $255M to common shareholders after $20M to noncontrolling interests and $42M of mandatory convertible preferred dividends. Operating income was $148M in the release; $1M of rounding is absorbed in the operating line here. Energy Storage sales are stated as $1.1B in the release; Corporate & other is the remainder.

oneTimers.label: Lithium price snap-back
oneTimers.text: Energy Storage pricing rose 68% year over year. Adjusted EBITDA nearly tripled to $646M — a reminder that Albemarle's earnings are, above all, a levered bet on the lithium price.

segments.name: Energy Storage (lithium)
segments.note: Lithium for EV batteries and grid storage — sales up 58% to $1.1B purely on pricing (+68%); volumes actually fell versus last year's record quarter. Segment Adjusted EBITDA $560M, up 351%.

segments.name: Specialties
segments.note: Bromine and lithium specialties — pricing +10%, volumes +3%; Adjusted EBITDA $99M, up 31%, and the full-year outlook was raised to $350–375M.

segments.name: Corporate & other
segments.note: Remainder after the two segments — Ketjen's refining-catalyst business is now an equity-method stake (51% sold in March 2026) whose results land in equity income, not sales.

sources.label: Albemarle Q3 2026 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Nov 4, 2026)

takeaways.text: Adjusted EBITDA nearly tripled to $646M. Nothing about the cost base explains that — lithium prices do. Energy Storage EBITDA alone rose 351%.
takeaways.title: It's the lithium price, again

takeaways.text: Equity earnings from joint ventures (mainly Talison) exceeded Albemarle's own operating income. The JV structure is where much of the lithium profit is booked.
takeaways.title: The JVs out-earn the parent

takeaways.text: Full-year capex guidance was cut again (from ~$500M) on capital-efficiency gains and resequenced projects — discipline while prices recover, with volumes guided to 225–235 kt LCE for the year.
takeaways.title: Capex discipline

verdict: The lithium roller-coaster is climbing again: prices +68% in Energy Storage tripled EBITDA and swung Albemarle back to a $317M profit.
